mapper.select: SELECT SEQ, NAME , PARENT_SEQ , URL , MATCH_URL , DEPTH, SORTING , CREATE_DATETIME, CREATE_IDX , UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_IDX FROM TB_MENU WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY `DEPTH` , SORTING

SELECT TM.SEQ, TM.NAME , TM.PARENT_SEQ , TM.URL , TM.MATCH_URL , TM.DEPTH, TM.SORTING , TM.CREATE_DATETIME, TM.CREATE_IDX , TM.UPDATE_DATETIME, TM.UPDATE_IDX FROM TB_USER TU INNER JOIN TB_AUTH TA ON TA.SEQ = TU.AUTH_SEQ INNER JOIN TB_AUTH_MENU TAM ON TAM.SEQ_AUTH = TA.SEQ INNER JOIN TB_MENU TM ON TM.SEQ = TAM.SEQ_MENU WHERE 1 = 1 AND TU.SEQ = 1 ORDER BY TM.`DEPTH` , TM.SORTING

SELECT M.SEQ, M.NAME , M.PARENT_SEQ, M.URL, M.MATCH_URL , M.DEPTH, M.SORTING , CASE WHEN AM.SEQ_AUTH IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS checked FROM TB_MENU M LEFT JOIN TB_AUTH_MENU AM ON AM.SEQ_MENU = M.SEQ AND AM.SEQ_AUTH = #{authSeq} WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY M.`DEPTH`, M.SORTING
